### Observed differences

- In the later window, A22 occurs in all 200 traces, exactly once per trace; in the earlier window it occurred in about 48 in 100 traces. [OCC001]
- In the later window, A27 and A28 are not observed in any trace, whereas each appeared in about 53 in 100 traces earlier (105 of 200), around the middle of the trace; their outgoing transitions — each split roughly half to A23 and half to the other activity of the pair — are likewise unobserved. [OCC002, OCC003, DIR002, DIR003, POS002, POS003]
- A21's observed successors change from a split of about 48 in 100 to A22, 27 to A27 and 26 to A28, to A22 in every later trace. [DIR001]
- In the later window, every trace shows the order A09 → A21 → A22 → A23: A22 co-occurs with, and follows, A09 and A21 in all traces, precedes A23 in all traces, and A23 always lies two event positions after A21 (earlier: two positions in about 48 in 100 traces, three in about 53). Earlier, A23 was preceded by A22 in about 48 in 100 traces and by A27 or A28 in the remainder, with A27 and A28 co-occurring in about 53 in 100 traces in either order. [REL007, REL010, REL013, REL016, REL017, REL018, LAG002]
- Secondary shifts: A07 and A08 each rise from about 47 to about 54 in 100 traces and, in the later window, always precede A22; A08's relative event position is slightly later (mean about 0.07 to 0.08 of the trace) and its gap to A09 shortens, with one-step gaps up from about 22 to about 42 in 100. [POS001, LAG001, REL001, REL004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the branch in which A27 and A28 executed between A21 and A23 is no longer taken, so that in the later window every observed case runs A09 → A21 → A22 → A23, with A22 — previously an alternative to the A27/A28 pair in roughly half of the cases — now executing exactly once in every trace. This is shown directly at three levels: participation (A22 up from about 48 in 100 traces to all 200; A27 and A28 down from about 53 in 100 to none), routing (A21's only observed successor is now A22), and relations (A22 sits between A21 and A23 in every later trace, while the earlier A27/A28 sequences are entirely absent). The 29 qualifying items are many times the roughly 0.44 expected for an unchanged process under this screening, so the pattern as a whole is unlikely to arise by chance, even though many items restate one underlying trace difference rather than confirming it independently. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, REL007, REL010, REL013, REL016, REL017, REL018, LAG002]

Limitations: zero participation means only that A27 and A28 were not observed in the later sample, and a difference in the mix of case variants between the two finite windows — for example, a later sample drawn only from A22-type cases — would look identical to this pattern; the fact that an activity present in about 53 in 100 earlier traces goes unobserved in 200 later traces makes pure sampling chance implausible but not impossible. The modest rise in A07/A08 participation (about 47 to about 54 in 100) and the small position and gap shifts around A08 could also reflect sampling variation rather than deliberate change. [OCC002, OCC003, REL001, REL004, POS001, LAG001]
